__doc: Cached machine-derived (REST Countries-origin) hard fields for every country. The REST Countries v3.1 API was deprecated (2026), so this committed snapshot is now the canonical source of hard fields. build_atlas.mjs merges it with atlas_soft.json (soft + slices). To add a country: add its hard fields here AND a soft entry in atlas_soft.json, then run build_atlas.mjs.
